title: Zero Trust: principles and what changes in the architecture

videos.script: The shop's staff handbook opens for any machine on the office network. No password. {{office}} From a café, the same page is refused, even to ana with her correct password. {{cafe}} So the portal admits the wrong person in the right place, and refuses the right person in the wrong place. Both mistakes come from one idea: trusting a location. {{location}} Zero Trust removes it. Every request proves who it is, every time, wherever it comes from. {{verify}} You will switch the lab's portal from one policy to the other and run the same requests again. Then you will see the parts a real Zero Trust design adds, and why it is a direction rather than a product you buy. {{direction}}
